voice.summary: Sounds like a friendly neighbour who happens to know about roofs: plain words, shared pronouns, a little sunshine. It speaks to residents and landlords alike, so it explains money and wiring without jargon.
dos: Say we and our block, never the customer
Put the saving next to the person it helps
Use short sentences and everyday words for kit and costs
donts: No engineering acronyms without a plain gloss
No guilt about carbon, lead with the shared bill
No lone-hero language about the founders

taglines: One roof, one bill, one block
Solar that the whole block owns
Make the roof pay its rent
boilerplate: Tessel & Thrive helps apartment blocks own their solar together, installing shared rooftop systems that cut bills and keep the benefit with the residents who live under them.
